description: This file contains utility functions for color manipulation, including contrast calculation, analogous color generation, alpha addition, and conversions between hex and rgb formats.

methods.name: getContrastingColor
methods.description: Calculates a contrasting color ('#000' or '#FFF') based on input color and threshold.

methods.name: getAnalogousColors
methods.description: Generates a list of analogous colors based on input colors and results parameter.

methods.name: addAlpha
methods.description: Adds an alpha transparency value to a color string.

methods.name: hexToRgb
methods.description: Converts a hex color string to an rgb string.

methods.name: rgbToHex
methods.description: Converts red, green, blue numeric values to a hex color string.
